24 Game Solver

Solve the 24 game exhaustively: every ordering, operation and parenthesization is tried with exact fraction arithmetic, and all distinct solutions are shown.

Solutions

    📖 How to use

    1. Type your four numbers (duplicates allowed).
    2. Press Solve — the tool tries all 4! orders × 64 operation combos × 5 parenthesizations.
    3. Read every distinct expression that equals 24, using + − × ÷ and parentheses.
    4. If none exists, the tool says so honestly after the full exhaustive search.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How does the exhaustive search work?

    It recursively combines pairs of numbers with +, −, ×, ÷ (both orders for − and ÷) until one value remains, tracking the expression string. With exact fractions there are no floating-point false positives or misses.

    Why use fractions instead of decimals?

    Expressions like (5 − 1/5) × 5 need exact thirds/fifths. Fraction arithmetic with GCD reduction guarantees a solution is reported only when it is exactly 24.

    Do all puzzles have a solution?

    No — e.g. 1, 1, 1, 1 cannot make 24. The solver searches the entire space (over 7,000 combinations) before concluding none exists.
